research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Figma is researching an interactive graphic design system spanning plugin management systems for an interactive system or platform, an interactive graphic design system to enable creation and use of variant components, and an auto layout inference engine. Work on design interface object manipulation based on aggregated property values, collaborative widget state synchronization, and systems and methods for implementing collaborator changes to shared content supports real time co-editing and robust collaboration.

overview_description.description: Figma is a design platform for teams who build products together. Figma helps the entire product team create, test, and ship better designs, faster. Whether the company tries to consolidate tools, get more eyes on your work, or collaborate across time zones, Figma boosts creative productivity while keeping everyone on the same page. On a mission to make design accessible to all, Figma is helping companies like Airbnb, Slack, and Microsoft with how they design.
